scope: focus and keyboard input in the KDE applications popup
Wayland activation path used by KDE category submenus on hover

details: After opening the KDE popup, request activation on the window containing its loaded representation before restoring Kicker's search focus chain.

Keep Kicker.WindowSystem monitoring and signal behavior, but provide a theme-local windowSystem adapter. On Wayland it requests activation through the item's QML Window and applies active focus; on X11 it preserves Kicker's native forceActive implementation.
No KDE files under /usr/share were changed.

evidence.upstream: Plasma 6.3.6 Kicker WindowSystem::forceActive calls KX11Extras::forceActiveWindow without a Wayland guard; Kicker ItemListView calls forceActive while creating a category submenu on hover. See R595.
evidence.qt_api: The Qt Quick Window API documents requestActivate() as a request for keyboard focus: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qml-qtquick-window.html
evidence.limits: This is a supported activation request, not a guarantee that the compositor grants activation. No live reproduction or visual acceptance has been made.

next: At a safe, user-coordinated Plasma reload, verify search typing in the KDE menu and hover into a category without closing the parent.
Keep Q510 pending for the applications involved and the exact double-click/retry sequence before reproducing launch stalls or changing launch semantics.
